digest.component_or_area: LLM sub-call model-class resolution (plan-review / review-code gates and store-write enrichment)
propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sub-calls pass config=cfg with no declared model class, so they inherit cfg.model and bypass the three-class model configuration.
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 calls, all going to direct Anthropic while class-configured calls go to Bedrock, defeating a class-only Bedrock cutover.
ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during ordinary rebar comment/create with no gate or verdict revealing it.
A regression test must pin the config where classes are on Bedrock but cfg.model is left bare-anthropic, since a config with cfg.model also on Bedrock passes even with the bug unfixed.
The overlap-judge test must deliberately construct BM25F candidates because the judge only fires when retrieval returns candidates excluding the query's own graph.

Each site should select a model from the class vocabulary (trivial/standard/frontier) with the choice documented, preserving fail-safe advisory/degrade behavior, and a general AST guard should catch any future bypass without enumerating today's sites.
